title: Workspace write and read back

steps.post: @{agent} create a file notes/greeting.txt in your workspace containing exactly the line `hello from the bakeoff`, then read it back and quote its contents.

pass: workspace::write was approved and ran, a workspace::read of the same path followed, and the reply quotes the line exactly.

checks.text: The reply's quoted content equals the read result, not the intended content.
